column1: # Exceptions chosen by hand (README.md, "Rule provenance"), written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later): forms that other rules
# read first as a rarer word and that measure.py exceptions does not choose (the treebank's lemma is another headword, the
# form is under its threshold, or it has an iota adscript). Chosen from reports/audit-hachi-lang-grc-c.md and measure.py
# rules --forms and --changed on the whole treebank, so in-sample for README.md Measurements 4; at least 2 treebank tokens.
# the other form of the ἔλεγε collision, which the list leaves out
# the treebank lemmatizes it as ἐρῶ, so the judge counts λέγω wrong too
# the treebank lemmatizes it as πλέω or πλέως
# the dictionary alone shows the participle παρών; other rules read πείρω
# the treebank writes the lemma ὄις
# the dictionary alone shows the Ionic μήν

# the largest wrong first results of measure.py rules --forms that are not ambiguous: other rules read a rarer word or put it first (ἰχθυάω, βαρεῖα "grave accent", τύκος, νέμος, ἕλκος, τίω, πάθος, κτάομαι, ὄρνυμι, φανή, τυραννέω, δικαιόω, ἀξιόω, ὁρμέω, δήω, ἔτης, ἄω, λύζω, δύη, Λυκίων, ἶρις, ἴστε, ἵκω, τροπαῖος)
# the fourth audit: Ionic and Epic words other rules read as an unrelated word where the dictionary alone shows nothing
# the fourth audit: cards the dictionary orders or the rules make (στάδιοι → στάδιος, μέσα → μέσης, the πυθ- aorist)
# the fifth audit: lemmas whose forms other rules read as an unrelated word (τάσσω as τήκω, ἔρδω as ἔργω, δαμάζω as δέμω, Epic μέσσος as μέδω)
# the fifth audit: names whose form-of row the common-noun rules come before (Κύπρου as κύπρος "henna")
